examples.note: Written by hand from a real page to show the format. No track 2 or 3 agent exists.

claim.quote: IL-22-011 intersected massive sulphide mineralization between 175.36 and 177.53 m. The mineralization was similar to IL-22-009, consisting of massive net-textured magnetite, rarely replaced by hematite, along with bands and veinlets of pyrite, pyrrhotite and trace chalcopyrite. This zone returned 0.30% copper and 0.049% nickel over 2.36 m.

code_result.rule_text: Two intervals for the same hole are the same interval when their depths overlap by at least 90% of the longer one. Code then compares them: widths more than 0.05 m apart disagree, and so does any grade both give that differs by more than the rounding of the numbers as written. An interval that lies inside a longer one is listed under it, the way reports write "including". Code also checks that to minus from equals the stated width, allowing for how precisely each number is written.
